description: Read the prompt, negative prompt, model and settings saved inside an image by AUTOMATIC1111, ComfyUI (including Flux workflows), InvokeAI or NovelAI. Only reads records stored in the file; it never reconstructs or guesses a prompt. Screenshots and re-uploads usually remove these records. Docs: https://isgenai.com/developers/mcp

image_base64.description: File bytes as base64 or a data: URL, up to 20 MiB decoded. Prefer url when the file is public.

url.description: Direct public URL of the original image file.

name: extract_saved_prompt
title: Read a saved image prompt
